exercises.name: squat
coaching_cues: Keep your chest up and your back neutral
Lower until your thighs are close to parallel with the floor
Keep your knees tracking over your toes
safety_warnings: Stop if you feel sharp pain in the hip, knee, or ankle
Do not round your lower back at the bottom
Hold onto a chair or counter for balance if needed

warmup: March in place for 2 minutes, then do 10 bodyweight good mornings and 10 leg swings per side.
cooldown: Walk slowly for 1 minute, then hold quadriceps and hamstring stretches for 30 seconds per leg.
overall_safety: This is a moderate-volume lower body plan. Keep every rep controlled. Stop and consult your physical therapist if pain increases during or after the session.
